records.text: lost Quartz Systems today, want to do a quick post-mortem on this one

records.subject: Sorry to see you go
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Confirming the cancellation on our end. We're sorry Wrenfield didn't end up being the right fit for Quartz Systems -- the door's open if that changes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Felix,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Glad to have Quartz Systems on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Quartz Systems* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, zero product progress: no project, no invite, no milestone, despite two nudges (email:29648fd4, email:a533e270) and a held onboarding call (calendar:db5f551f) with no customer reply ever. No tickets signals low engagement; 8 days left, so some chance post-call follow-through occurs unaided.

draft.subject: Following up on our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call last week. As promised, I wanted to follow up with one small next step: getting a first real project set up, since projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work to set up that first project together? Happy to work from whatever your team is already tracking.

Best,
Chidi
